sessionStart.bash: mkdir -p logs && echo "[$(date)] Copilot session started" >> logs/copilot-session.log
sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs\copilot-session.log -Value "[$(Get-Date)] Copilot session started"

sessionEnd.bash: mkdir -p logs && echo "[$(date)] Copilot session ended" >> logs/copilot-session.log
sessionEnd.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path logs | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs\copilot-session.log -Value "[$(Get-Date)] Copilot session ended"
